name: Manic Pixie Dreamgirls
source:
In dreams, there's nothing to hold back one's deepest desires. But at the same time, they're also where the most brutal nightmares roam. 

Four students are hiding a great secret - they are dream fairies who can use their magic to influence the lives of their loved ones. Whose dream will they enter tonight?

[Translated from [url=https://kajancollaboration.itch.io/manic-pixie-dreamgirls]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在梦中，没有什么可以阻挡一个人最深切的渴望。但与此同时，它们也是最残酷的噩梦出现的地方。

四名学生隐藏着一个巨大的秘密——他们是梦想仙子，可以用自己的魔法影响亲人的生活。今晚他们将进入谁的梦境？

[译自[url=https://kajancollaboration.itch.io/manic-pixie-dreamgirls]itch.io[/url]]
